metadata.description: Recommended Cursor plugins for the SecureBroker (website-insurance-broker) monorepo — React, Supabase, Vite, Tailwind.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Database, auth, storage, migrations, and project debugging (primary backend).

plugins.name: shadcn
plugins.description: shadcn/ui registry search, component install, and project audits.

plugins.name: browse
plugins.description: Browser automation for local dev smoke tests and UI verification.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Design-to-code, Figma MCP, and Code Connect.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Deployments, env vars, Next.js/Vite guidance, AI SDK patterns.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Workers, Wrangler, Durable Objects — use if deploying on Cloudflare.

plugins.name: cursor-team-kit
plugins.description: CI loops, code review, verify-this, smoke tests, shipping workflows.

plugins.name: agent-compatibility
plugins.description: Repo compatibility scans — startup, docs, validation paths.

plugins.name: continual-learning
plugins.description: Keeps AGENTS.md in sync with durable workspace learnings.

plugins.name: docs-canvas
plugins.description: Architecture notes and runbooks as navigable Canvases.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Deep planning before implementation — how/why/unslop workflows.

plugins.name: cursor-sdk
plugins.description: Automate Cursor agents from scripts and CI via @cursor/sdk.

plugins.name: 1password
plugins.description: Secure secrets for Supabase keys and env files.

plugins.name: tierzero
plugins.description: Production incident investigation (enable when you have TierZero).

plugins.name: notion-workspace
plugins.description: Notion tasks and docs MCP (enable if team uses Notion).

plugins.name: vantage
plugins.description: Cloud cost visibility (enable if using Vantage).

plugins.name: huggingface-skills
plugins.description: HF Hub, training jobs, datasets — only for ML experiments.

plugins.name: forge-skills
plugins.description: Atlassian Forge apps — skip unless building Jira/Confluence extensions.
